occurrences.quote: The claim contains a significant factual error. While the passages confirm that the New York and New Jersey campaign was indeed "a series of engagements for control of New York City and the state of New Jersey," they reveal that the claim incorrectly dates the Battle of Harlem.

The claim appears to conflate these two separate battles by stating that "the campaign, during which the first Battle of Harlem was fought" occurred on October 28, 1776 near White Plains. This is inaccurate - the Battle of Harlem occurred over six weeks earlier (September 16), while the Battle of White Plains occurred on October 28.
